 India women’s team will face Zimbabwe women’s team in the second ODI game today of the three match series. India has a 1-0 lead in the series as they won the first ODI
 by Chetan Phore | Oct 25, 2026 | 2 mins read Mandhana and Nkomo during the toss in the T20I series · Credits: Via X Cricket Newly appointed captain Smriti Mandhana will look to finish the ODI series today only by marking another achievement of hers in her first series as the captain as India women’s team step on to the field today against the Zimbabwe women’s team in the second ODI game with a firm believe of winning the series today as they are already carrying a 1-0 lead in the three match series after their 9 wicket victory in the first ODI.
 “Coming into a different ground, I think the bowlers adapted really well, especially Shree Charani, I think standout bowler for us. Also the pacers, the way they bowled, Kranti to mention, out of all the bowlers, they were pretty disciplined. Yes, we can tidy up our fielding, a few catches went down our way, but otherwise, again Shafali and Pratika went about that chase, and it was a masterclass. Well, we are playing fifty overs after a very long time. We have played T20 cricket for almost last seven months, so definitely the period between 20 to 35, I would say, we could have had more intensity on the field. That is something which we will take it back from a game and work on,” Mandhana stated yesterday.
 Sunday special comin' up: Smriti & Co. looking to wrap the series up in style 🆚 Zimbabwe. 😎💙

 When and Where to Watch?
 Date: Sunday, October 25, 2026
 Time: 2:00 PM IST (Toss at 1:30 PM IST)
 Venue: BCA Stadium, Kotambi, Vadodara, Gujarat, India
 Broadcast: Star Sports Network and DD Sports
 Live Streaming: JioHotstar app and website
 Pitch Report
 The average first innings score in Kotambi is approximately 258 runs. The surface of the ground is generally well. The pitch shows good bounce in the early half of the first innings but gradually it converts into a batter friendly pitch. The latest example was the Indian women’s team itself who won the first ODI while chasing 198 runs in just 27.1 overs.
 Weather Report
 Clear sky, autumn weather and warm afternoon with the temperature staying between 32°C to 34°C during the maximum duration of the day, while the temperature is expected to drop to make the weather comfortable in the evening. No chances of rain.
 Squads of both the teams
 India Women Squad: Pratika Rawal, Smriti Mandhana (captain), Shafali Verma, Harmanpreet Kaur, Tejal Hasabnis, Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (wicketkeeper), Shree Charani, Kranti Gaud, Sayali Satghare, Jintimani Kalita, Harleen Deol, Yastika Bhatia, Vaishnavi Sharma, Nandani Sharma
 Zimbabwe Women Squad: Modester Mupachikwa (wicketkeeper), Loryn Phiri, Chipo Mugeri-Tiripano, Beloved Biza, Sharne Mayers, Nyasha Gwanzura, Chiedza Dhururu, Michelle Mavunga, Nomvelo Sibanda (captain), Tendai Makusha, Olinder Chare, Kudzai Chigora, Francisca Chipare, Kelis Ndhlovu, Josephine Nkomo
